newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends mixed, off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends mixed, off lows.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures ended mixed after a move up from earlier lows which left October in positive territory.
Front month August last traded 30 cents lower at $321.00, while October last traded 60 cents higher at $316.20, up from a low of $314.30
August was the most active month, with 755 of a total 1,746 lots done.
A mixed bag of players, including brokerages, commission and trade houses, moved into the London market after the New York open. Earlier activity on the whites had been lacklustre, traders said.
"It's just bits and bobs...nobody's really taking it by the scruff of the neck, it's just routine trading," said one market source.
